name: Social Media Content Pipeline & Review Gate

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO posts (platform, topic, hook, caption, media_path, status, scheduled_at)
VALUES (
  'all',
  '{{ $('Clean & Parse AI Output').item.json.topic.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Clean & Parse AI Output').item.json.hook.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Clean & Parse AI Output').item.json.caption.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.video_path }}',
  'pending_approval',
  DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR)
);
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID() as post_id;
